what: Each model was asked for every glass top, in 5 real frames (compared with the bright-top reader's spots) and 5 cluttered simulated scenes (compared with true positions). A point within 4 cm of a glass counts as finding it.
note: Every model gave one extra point in task3_flip_right_take1. That video's reader spots were counted only in the first 2 s, so the extra point may be a real glass the reader saw later, not a mistake.
